info.description:
### Welcome to Postman! This is your first collection. 

Collections are your starting point for building and testing APIs. You can use this one to:

• Group related requests
• Test your API in real-world scenarios
• Document and share your requests

Update the name and overview whenever you’re ready to make it yours.

[Learn more about Postman Collections.](https://learning.postman.com/docs/collections/collections-overview/)

item.name: Instructions (click on this folder)
item.description:
### Before you start

1. Start everything with docker compose up (see the README) in project root.
    
2. Open [http://localhost:8500](http://localhost:8500) (Consul) and wait until all services are green. This can take a minute. Requests sent before that may fail with 503.
    

### Logging in

Run (Auth) Login first. It saves the tokens, and all other requests use them automatically.  
Without a valid login, requests return 401. Register, Login and the goal catalog work without login.  
The token expires after 1 hour. Run (Auth) Refresh or Login again.  
After (Auth) Logout, log in again before sending more requests.

What's in the collection  
Passing requests: the normal flow.  
Failing requests: sent on purpose to show the error responses (400, 401, 404, 409).

Every request can be sent as it is, without changing anything.  
Test user: [demo@lifeos.no](https://mailto:demo@lifeos.no) / demo1234  
baseUrl: [http://localhost:8100](http://localhost:8100) (API gateway)

REMEMBER TO LOG IN AGAIN IF PASSING REQUESTS ARE FAILING! :)
